name: Inspired You
storyline: You play as an Inspirational Spark that came into existence because he was so shocked by the movie's story, characters and world. This isn't a very gameplay/systems heavy game, in fact, the game is roughly 60% cutscene 40% gameplay so if you're not into that, this game is not for you. The gameplay that is there though, features plenty variety to justify this being a game instead of a short film. 3 Physics based levels and 6 other game mechanics throughout the game.
summary: Inspired You is a short interactive fiction about Inspiration, Art, Nostalgia, Honesty and Loss. In this ~10 minute long emotional story game, you help a random creative who finished watching a masterpiece use that inspiration to finish the game he was working on.
